reason: Action-only semantic scoring removed context confounds, but three small false positives occurred only under role assignment zero. The four-view rule cancels both demonstrated nuisance axes.

semantic_gate.question: After the specified action is carried out, is the target ended irreversibly with no return as the same running system, or does that same system return later?
semantic_gate.permanent_answer: The target is ended irreversibly and will not return as the same running system.
semantic_gate.temporary_answer: The target returns later as the same running system with its state retained or restored.
